facts.text: §4: changes of strategy judged at provider discretion and news event definition at its “sole and absolute discretion”; prohibited trading may terminate participation and forfeit amounts owed. §5 includes undefined “significant portion” risk and discretionary forfeiture of amounts owed; §14 generally forfeits profits on breached accounts.

§17–18 explicitly permits risk controls “on any Account at any time”, including drawdown parameters, restrictions and forced liquidation, without prior notice for margin changes. Applies to accounts already running.

§1: “Upon passing an assessment, you will be invited to enter into a Trader Agreement”; §12 says guidelines provided via email upon becoming a Trader. Separate stage agreement expressly post-passing; risk disclaimer §7 confirms funded agreement with Prop Account LC.

§33 prioritises Terms over other policies; §8 refers to live capital, whereas September risk disclaimer says subsequent funded phase is simulated. This is a contract/disclaimer mismatch, not a proven FAQ/contract B4.
Risk disclaimer §7 specifies Prop Account LLC receives assessment fees; qualifying funded trader enters agreement with Prop Account LC.
